overview_description.description: Galactech is a gaming startup building a gaming Super App for users allowing them to access multiple gaming services at the same time from in-game currency purchases to Esports tournaments to professional game training and other gaming-related services. It aims to ease up the access to said services without having to have specific payment methods or specific devices.
